items.title: Emile Barnes and Paul Barnes Interview, 1959-10-01
items.q: when Piro and them returned in 1924, the Tuxedo band came out.

ctx.x: I don't think it was Lorenzo, but he was from the daddy. Anyway, when Piro and them returned in 1924, the Tuxedo band came out. And you heard some of the recordings that we made.
